claim: Charges stop as soon as an instance enters the stopping state (for hibernation, only when it reaches stopped); each transition from stopped to running starts a new billing period with a minimum of one minute, and a reboot does not change the billing hour.
question: When do charges stop on stop, hibernate and terminate, and what minimum is billed on every start?

values.display: minimum of one minute every time you start your instance
values.spoken: a one-minute minimum on every start

values.display: stop incurring charges for an instance as soon as its state changes to stopping
The instance billing hour doesn't change
values.spoken: a reboot does not change the billing hour

qualifiers.condition: Amazon EBS-backed instances for stop/start and hibernate
